summary: One-church parish with no open questions. All three bulletins give Saturday 6:30 PM and Sunday 8:00 AM Masses, Saturday Confession after the 6:30 Mass (7:30 PM by POLICY) and Wednesday 6-7 PM Adoration at the church. The first-Friday 9:00 AM Adoration is seen only in the Sep 27 bulletin (R12). The Oct 31 vigil is cancelled and the Nov 1 Sunday Mass moves from 8:00 to 10:30 AM for the Bishop's visit. The parish website could not be read.
